entities.summary: Takanori Arisawa (b. 1951-04-04, Tokyo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tokyo and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
